src: You only manifest physical mutations, and all of your mutation choices when manifesting a new mutation are physical.
Whenever you manifest a new mutation, one of your choices will also cause you to grow a new limb at random.
You only manifest mental mutations, and all of your mutation choices when manifesting a new mutation are mental.
You gain one extra mutation each time you buy this, but the mutations don't manifest right away.
Whenever you gain a level, there's a 33% chance that your genome destabilizes and you get to choose from 3 random mutations.
those with control over their adrenal glands
You regulate your body's release of adrenaline.
You can increase your body's adrenaline flow for <stat Name="Duration" />.
While it's flowing, you gain +<stat Name="QuicknessBonus" /> quickness and other physical mutations gain +<stat Name="MutationBonus" Unit="▶rank" />.
Your face bears a sightly <stat Name="BeakName" />.
You occasionally peck at your opponents.
You bear spade-like claws that can burrow through the earth.
<gametext>=weapon.Name|pluralize=</gametext> destroy walls after <stat Name="WallHits" Unit="▶penetrating hit" />.
Can dig passages up or down when outside of combat
<gametext>=weapon.Name|pluralize= are also a =weaponClass.name= class natural weapon that deal <stat Name="Damage" /> base damage to non-walls.</gametext>
You are protected by a durable carapace.
You may tighten your <stat Name="CarapaceName" /> to receive double the AV bonus at a -2 DV penalty as long as you remain still.
You release a burst of <stat Name="GasName" /> around yourself.
You are possessed of hulking strength.
<stat Name="DazeChance" />% chance to daze your opponent on a successful melee attack for 2-3 rounds
You accrue electrical charge that you can use and discharge to deal damage.
Accrue base <stat Name="BaseChargePerTurn" /> charge per turn
Can discharge all held charge for 1d4 damage per <stat Name="DischargeChunk" /> charge
Discharge can arc to adjacent targets dealing reduced damage, up to 1 target per <stat Name="DischargeChunk" /> charge
EMP causes involuntary discharge (difficulty 18 Willpower save)
You can drink change from electrical power sources.
You can drink charge from energy cells and capacitors.
You gain <stat Name="DamageAbsorbFactor" /> charge per point of electrical damage taken.
You can provide charge to equipped devices that have integrated power.
You generate an electromagnetic pulse that disables nearby artifacts and machines.
You emit a ray of flame<switch Name="BodyPartName"><case Value="" /><default> from your <stat Name="BodyPartName" /></default></switch>.
Emits a <stat Name="Range" />-square ray of flame in the direction of your choice.
Melee attacks heat opponents by <stat Name="HeatOnHit" Unit="▶degree" />
You emit a ray of frost<switch Name="BodyPartName"><case Value="" /><default> from your <stat Name="BodyPartName" /></default></switch>.
Emits a <stat Name="Range" />-square ray of frost in the direction of your choice.
Melee attacks cool opponents by <stat Name="CoolOnHit" Unit="▶degree" />
You are possessed of unnaturally acute hearing.
You detect the presence of creatures within a radius of <stat Name="Radius" />.
Chance to identify nearby detected creatures
{{rules|Increased chance to identify nearby detected creatures}}
You are gifted with tremendous speed.
20% chance on melee attack to gore your opponent
You assume the form of any creature you touch.
May only assume the form of creatures level <stat Name="MaxLevel" /> or lower.
You have an extra set of arms.
<stat Name="AttackChance" />% chance for each extra arm to deliver an additional melee attack whenever you make a melee attack
You have an extra set of legs.
You may phase through solid objects for brief periods of time.
You replenish yourself by absorbing sunlight through your hearty green skin.

You can bask in the sunlight instead of eating a meal to gain a special metabolizing effect for <stat Name="DurationDay" Unit="▶day" />: +<stat Name="BonusRegen" /> to natural healing rate and +<stat Name="BonusQuickness" /> Quickness
While in the sunlight, you accrue starch and lignin that you can use as ingredients in meals you cook (max <stat Name="StarchServings" Unit="▶serving" /> of each).
+<stat Name="BonusCamoflage" /> DV while occupying the same space as foliage
+200 reputation with {{w|roots}}, {{w|trees}}, {{w|vines}}, and {{w|the Consortium of Phyta}}
Hundreds of needle-pointed quills cover your body.
May expel 10% of your <stat Name="Quills" /> in a burst around yourself (<gametext>=pv=<stat Name="QuillPen" /> =damage=<stat Name="QuillDamage" /></gametext>)
Regenerate <stat Name="Quills" /> at the approximate rate of <stat Name="RegenRate" /> per round
+<stat Name="AV" /> AV as long as you retain half your <stat Name="Quills" /> (+<stat Name="AVWithPenalty" /> AV otherwise)
Creatures attacking you in melee may impale themselves on your <stat Name="Quills" />, breaking roughly 1% of them and reflecting 3% damage per <stat Name="Quill" /> broken.
Your full natural healing rate applies in combat.
<stat Name="RegenChance" />% chance to regrow a missing limb each round
<stat Name="DebuffChance" />% chance to remove a {{rules|minor physical debuff}} at random each round
<stat Name="DebuffChance" />% chance to remove a {{rules|physical debuff}} at random each round
You release a burst of <stat Name="GasName" /> around yourself.
You produce a viscous slime that you can spit at things.
You can walk over slime without slipping.
You can spin sticky silk webs.
While spinning, you leave webs in your wake as you move.
You are immune to getting stuck.
those with stingers tipped with confusing venom
You bear a tail with a stinger that delivers <stat Name="VenomType" /> venom to your enemies.
20% chance on melee attack to sting your opponent (<gametext>=pv=<stat Name="StingerPen" /> =damage=<stat Name="StingerDamage" /></gametext>)
Stinger is a long blade and can only penetrate once.
Always sting on charge or lunge.
Stinger applies venom on damage (only 20% chance if Stinger is your primary weapon).
May use Sting activated ability to strike with your stinger and automatically hit and penetrate.
those with stingers tipped with paralyzing venom
You bear a tail with a stinger that delivers <stat Name="VenomType" /> venom to your enemies.
20% chance on melee attack to sting your opponent (<gametext>=pv=<stat Name="StingerPen" /> =damage=<stat Name="StingerDamage" /></gametext>)

Always sting on charge or lunge.
Stinger applies venom on damage (only 20% chance if Stinger is your primary weapon).
May use Sting activated ability to strike with your stinger and automatically hit and penetrate.
those with stingers tipped with poisoning venom
You bear a tail with a stinger that delivers <stat Name="VenomType" /> venom to your enemies.
20% chance on melee attack to sting your opponent <gametext>(=pv=<stat Name="StingerPen" /> =damage=<stat Name="StingerDamage" /></gametext>)
Stinger is a long blade and can only penetrate once.
Always sting on charge or lunge.
Stinger applies venom on damage (only 20% chance if Stinger is your primary weapon).
May use Sting activated ability to strike with your stinger and automatically hit and penetrate.
Venom poisons opponents for <stat Name="Duration" /> (damage increment <stat Name="PoisonDamage" />)
You are covered in a thick coat of fur, which protects you from the elements.
Your joints stretch much further than usual.
<stat Name="Chance" />% chance that Sprint and skills with Agility prerequisites don't go on cooldown after use
Mental actions have <stat Name="MentalActionDiscount" />% lower action costs
<stat Name="ShakeOff" />% chance initially and each round to shake off a negative mental status effect
You can sprint for <stat Name="SprintBonus" />% longer.
You travel on the world map at <stat Name="WorldMapTravelSpeed" />x speed.
<stat Name="LostSaveBonus" />% reduced chance of becoming lost
While outside, you may fly. You cannot be hit in melee by grounded creatures while flying.
<stat Name="CrashChance" />% chance of falling clumsily to the ground
<stat Name="SprintingMoveSpeedBonus" Filters="signed" />% move speed while sprinting
You can jump <stat Name="JumpDistanceBonus" Unit="▶square" /> farther.
You can charge <stat Name="ChargeDistanceBonus" Unit="▶square" /> farther.
Your skin, hair, and eyes are absent of pigment.
You regenerate hit points at one-fifth the usual rate in the daylight.
Your skin must be kept moist with fresh water.
You pour water on yourself rather than drinking it to quench your thirst.
You require about two-thirds more water than usual.
You suffer 50% more damage from bludgeoning attacks, falling, and other sources of concussive damage.
You lack a developed sense of pain.
You only know your general state of health and not your precise number of hit points.
You get no satiation from foods that aren't meat.
If you eat raw food that isn't meat, there's a 50% chance you become ill for 2 hours.
You can't cook with plant or fungus ingredients.
You don't get ill when you eat raw meat.
You can eat raw meat without being famished.
Your vitality depends on your temperature; at higher temperatures, you are more lively. At lower temperatures, you are more torpid.
Your base quickness score is reduced by 10.
Your quickness increases as your temperature increases and decreases as your temperature decreases.
those who cannot control their electromagnetic pulses
You involuntarily release electromagnetic pulses, deactivating robots and artifacts around yourself.
Small chance each round you're in combat that you release an electromagnetic pulse with radius 3, deactivating robots and artifacts (including those you carry) for 11-20 rounds.
Your genome is irritable and unpredictable.
Whenever you spend a mutation point, the next mutation point you gain will be spent randomly.
Whenever you buy a new mutation, you get a random one instead of a choice of three.
You can only see up to a radius of 10.
Small chance each round you're in combat that you spontaneously erupt into flames.
The chance your mutant physiology reacts adversely to a tonic is increased to 33%.
If you react adversely this way to a salve or ubernostrum tonic, the adverse reaction effect is chosen randomly from among other tonic effects. You will still heal.
You beguile a nearby creature into serving you loyally.
Mental attack versus a creature with a mind
Success roll: {{rules|mutation rank}} or Ego mod (whichever is higher) + character level + 1d8 vs. Defender MA + character level
Beguiled creature: +<stat Name="BonusHP" /> bonus hit points
You cause plants to spontaneously grow in a nearby area, hindering your enemies.
Area: <stat Name="Area" /> + growth into adjacent tiles
You briefly gain vision of a nearby area.
Affected creatures act semi-randomly and receive a -<stat Name="Penalty" /> penalty to their mental abilities.
You chill a nearby area with your mind.
Chills affected area over <stat Name="Duration" />, dealing damage and freezing things
You are exhausted for 3 rounds after using this power.
those who dominate the wills of others
You garrote an adjacent creature's mind and control its actions while your own body lies dormant.
Mental attack versus creature with a mind
Success roll: {{rules|mutation rank}} or Ego mod (whichever is higher) + character level + 1d8 vs. Defender MA + character level
those who project their egos onto the physical realm
Through sheer force of will, you perform uncanny physical feats.
Augments one physical attribute by an amount equal to twice your Ego bonus
You generate a forcefield around yourself.
Creates a 3x3 forcefield centered on yourself
You may fire missile weapons through the forcefield.
You generate a wall of force that protects you from your enemies.
Creates 9 contiguous squares of immobile forcefield.
You may fire missile weapons through the forcefield.
You ignite a small fire with your mind.
You manipulate light to your advantage.
You produce ambient light within a radius of <stat Name="Radius" />.
You may focus the light into a laser beam, temporarily reducing the radius of your ambient light by 1.
Ambient light recharges at a rate of 1 unit every <stat Name="AmbientRegrowthDuration" Unit="▶round" /> until it reaches its maximum value.
<stat Name="ReflectChance" />% chance to reflect light-based damage
those who tap the Mass Mind
You tap into the aggregate mind and steal power from other espers.
Cooldown is not affected by Willpower.
Each use attracts slightly more attention from psychic interlopers.
Small chance each round for another esper to steal your powers
{{rules|Decreased chance for another esper to steal your powers}}
-200 reputation with {{w|the Seekers of the Sightless Way}}
You reflect mental attacks back at your attackers.
When you suffer a mental attack while Mental Mirror is off cooldown, you gain +<stat Name="BonusMA" /> mental armor (MA).
If the attack then fails to penetrate your MA, it's reflected back at your attacker.
You peer into your near future.
You may activate this power and then later revert to the point in time when you activated it.
Duration between use and reversion: <stat Name="Duration" />
You read the history of artifacts by touching them, learning what they do and how they were made.
Unerringly identify artifacts up to complexity tier <stat Name="IdentifyComplexity" />.
Learn how to construct identified artifacts up to complexity tier <stat Name="ConstructComplexity" /> (must have the appropriate Tinker skill).
You may open security doors and use some secure devices by touching them.
You heat a nearby area with your mind.
You can sense other mental mutants through the psychic aether.
You detect the presence of psychic enemies within a radius of <stat Name="Radius" />.
There's a chance you identify detected enemies.
You sunder spacetime, sending things nearby careening through a tear in the cosmic fabric.
Summons a vortex that swallows everything in its path.
You may enter the vortex to teleport to a random location in Qud.
You invoke a concussive force in a nearby area, throwing enemies back and stunning them.
Creatures are pushed away from center of blast, stunned, and dealt crushing damage in up to 3 increments.
You sunder the mind of an enemy, leaving them reeling in pain.
For up to 10 rounds, you engage in psychic combat with an opponent, dealing damage each round.
Taking any action other than passing the turn will break the connection.
Each round you make a mental attack vs. mental armor (MA).
After the tenth round, you deal bonus damage equal to the total amount of damage you've done so far.
You bond with a nearby organic creature and leech its life force.
Mental attack versus an organic creature
Drains <stat Name="HP" Unit="▶hit point" /> per round
Target gets a mental save to resist damage each round
You may communicate with others through the psychic aether.
Takes you much less time to issue orders to companions
You teleport to a nearby location.
Teleport to a random location within a designated area.
You teleport an adjacent creature to a random nearby location.
You distort time around your person in order to slow down your enemies.
Creatures within <stat Name="Range" /> tiles are slowed according to how close they are to you.
Distance 1: creatures receive a <stat Name="QuicknessPenalty1" />% Quickness penalty
Distance 4: creatures receive a <stat Name="QuicknessPenalty4" />% Quickness penalty
Distance 7: creatures receive a <stat Name="QuicknessPenalty7" />% Quickness penalty
You quickly pass back and forth through time creating multiple copies of yourself.
Whenever you learn a new secret, there's a small chance you forget a secret.
Whenever you return to a map you previously visited, there's a small chance you forget the layout.
Small chance each round you're in combat that you randomly teleport to a nearby location.
those who are befuddled by technological complexity
You are befuddled by technological complexity.
You're much worse at examining artifacts.
You can't have artifacts identified for you because you don't understand their explanations.
When you fail severely during artifact examination, the artifact explodes.
Acting on some inscrutable impulse, a parallel version of yourself travels through space and time to destroy you.
Each time you embark on a new location, there's a small chance your evil twin has tracked you there and attempts to kill you.
You fall asleep involuntarily from time to time.
Small chance each round you're in combat that you fall asleep for 20-29 rounds.
those who suffer from psionic migraines
You suffer from powerful psionic migraines that render your head extremely sensitive.
You can't wear hats or helmets.
Your willful acts sometimes dent spacetime.

Whenever you use an activated ability, there's a small chance your focus slips and you dent spacetime in the local region, causing 1-2 spacetime vortices to appear. This chance increases the longer you go without using an activated ability.
Others find it difficult to tolerate you in social settings.
